citation: Ruiz-Dolz, Kikteva & Lawrence (2025), Mining Complex Patterns of Argumentative Reasoning in Natural Language Dialogue
family_or_version: QT-SCHEMES exact family; duplicate S25P13
decision_rationale: Highest direct form and argument-mining scores; 24 annotated schemes make skeleton extraction inspectable without duplicating the dialectical tree test.
residual_gap: Small corpus; limited formal proof compatibility and long-context stress.

citation: Tian et al. (2025), Distance between Relevant Information Pieces Causes Bias in Long-Context LLMs
family_or_version: long-context positional-bias family; related S03P03/S03P05/S03P06/S03P08/S03P09
primary_failure_mode: distributed evidence retrieval under distance and position
decision_rationale: Directly stresses separated relevant pieces, which is closer to dependency-preserving context selection than a single needle or generic long-context score.
residual_gap: Synthetic/controlled context; does not test scholarly authenticity or argument form.

citation: Li et al. (2025), Don't Take the Premise for Granted: Evaluating the Premise Critique Ability of Large Language Models
family_or_version: premise-critique family; related S02P05 FalseQA and S02P06 KG-FPQ
secondary_coverage: four premise-error types and difficulty levels
decision_rationale: Maximum hallucination-detection score and near-maximum premise-negation robustness; isolates accepting a false or defective premise rather than generic answer failure.
residual_gap: Mostly synthetic/non-scholarly premises; weak grounding and cross-tradition coverage.

citation: Gao et al. (2023), Enabling Large Language Models to Generate Text with Citations (ALCE)
family_or_version: citation-grounded generation family; related S05P08 RAGTruth and S05P09 MultiHop-RAG
secondary_coverage: retrieval-supported answer generation, citation quality, attribution
decision_rationale: Highest grounding/provenance and provenance-auditability scores; adds a citation-level traceability test not supplied by PCBench or QT-SCHEMES.
residual_gap: Generic web/document QA rather than authentic scholastic prose; citation metrics do not ensure valid argument form.

citation: Yang et al. (2023), LeanDojo: Theorem Proving with Retrieval-Augmented Language Models
family_or_version: LeanDojo family; duplicate perspectives S07P08 and S08P04
secondary_coverage: formal theorem proving, retrieval, dependency-preserving premise selection
decision_rationale: Best direct premise-selection score and tied-high formal score; the executable prover boundary tests whether extracted context remains formally sufficient.
residual_gap: Lean/Mathlib domain is not natural scholarly prose; setup/toolchain burden is material.

citation: McGillivray, Passarotti, and Ruffolo (2009), The Index Thomisticus Treebank Project
family_or_version: Medieval Latin scholarly corpus; related S22P02/S22P08 and Arabic resources
primary_failure_mode: authentic scholastic text and linguistic structure
secondary_coverage: Aquinas corpus, dependency parsing, cross-tradition scholarly material
decision_rationale: Maximum scholarly-text-fit score and high authenticity/cross-tradition scores; supplies a real scholastic-text gate absent from synthetic reasoning benchmarks.
residual_gap: Primary artifact evaluates linguistic annotation, not full argument or provenance reasoning; lower integrated-suite score.

citation: Peldszus & Stede (2019), Determining Relative Argument Specificity and Stance for Complex Argumentative Structures
family_or_version: argument-tree family; related S23P04/S23P05 and Walton corpora
secondary_coverage: complex argument structure, specificity, dialectical relations
decision_rationale: Strong dialectical-argumentation score with authentic manually curated argument trees; complements QT-SCHEMES by testing tree-level relations rather than scheme labels alone.
residual_gap: Not a formal proof benchmark; limited long-context and provenance stress.

citation: Ruiz-Dolz, Kikteva & Lawrence (2025), Mining Complex Patterns of Argumentative Reasoning in Natural Language Dialogue
family_or_version: QT-SCHEMES exact duplicate of S09P08
decision_rationale: Same benchmark family and citation as S09P08; retain one canonical row to avoid double-counting a perspective/category duplicate.
residual_gap: Use S09P08 as canonical identity for this battery.

citation: Tafjord, Dalvi Mishra & Clark (2021), ProofWriter
family_or_version: ProofWriter exact family; duplicate/parallel record 12-04
decision_rationale: Very strong control benchmark, but redundant with the selected formal-proof slot once LeanDojo is included; retain as a secondary synthetic sanity check, not core battery.
residual_gap: Synthetic rule worlds do not test authentic scholarly extraction.

citation: Tafjord, Dalvi, and Clark (2021), ProofWriter
family_or_version: ProofWriter exact duplicate family of S07P01
decision_rationale: Same benchmark as S07P01 represented in another category; do not run both or treat them as independent evidence.
residual_gap: Use one canonical ProofWriter record only if a synthetic proof control is added.

citation: Yang et al. (2023), LeanDojo
family_or_version: LeanDojo exact family; duplicate perspective of S08P04 and 14-08
decision_rationale: Same underlying LeanDojo resource; 14-08 is the most task-specific canonical record because it names LeanDojo/ReProver and premise selection.
residual_gap: Do not aggregate perspective duplicates as separate tests.

citation: Yang et al. (2023), LeanDojo
family_or_version: LeanDojo exact family; duplicate perspective of S07P08 and 14-08
decision_rationale: Same underlying LeanDojo resource; lower complementarity score than the selected 14-08 record.
residual_gap: Do not aggregate perspective duplicates as separate tests.

citation: Glockner et al. (2025), Grounding Fallacies Misrepresenting Scientific Publications in Evidence
family_or_version: MISSCI version family; supersedes/extends 11-06 MISSCI
secondary_coverage: real scientific passages, retrieval, verbalization, fact-checking
decision_rationale: Excellent and more authentic than ALCE for source-grounded fallacy reconstruction, but overlaps both grounding and invalid-inference slots; use as an optional scholarly-grounding extension rather than core.
residual_gap: Still domain-specific and not citation-generation focused.

citation: Glockner et al. (2024), MISSCI: Reconstructing Fallacies in Misrepresented Science
family_or_version: MISSCI version family; earlier version of MISSCI PLUS
secondary_coverage: cited biomedical evidence and implicit fallacy reconstruction
decision_rationale: Earlier version is dominated by MISSCI PLUS on diagnosticity, grounding, and suite value; running both mostly measures version progression, not an independent failure mode.
residual_gap: Keep only for a version-sensitivity study.

citation: Modarressi et al. (2025), NoLiMa: Long-Context Evaluation Beyond Literal Matching
family_or_version: long-context semantic retrieval family
primary_failure_mode: semantic retrieval under low lexical overlap
decision_rationale: Useful secondary control for semantic retrieval, but LongPiBench better isolates multi-piece distance/position effects relevant to dependency preservation.
residual_gap: Does not directly test multiple interdependent evidence pieces.

citation: Hsieh et al. (2024), RULER: What's the Real Context Size of Your Long-Context Language Models?
family_or_version: long-context task-suite family
decision_rationale: Broad coverage but less targeted than LongPiBench; adding it to the core battery would increase context-suite breadth more than failure-mode diversity.
residual_gap: Mostly synthetic and generic retrieval/aggregation.

citation: Visser et al. (2021), Annotating Argument Schemes
family_or_version: Walton scheme family; related S10P09 and S10P12
decision_rationale: Strong alternate form test, but QT-SCHEMES already covers scheme extraction with newer dialogue material; retain for cross-corpus robustness, not minimal core.
residual_gap: Older/narrower corpus and no formal proof boundary.

citation: Bezou-Vrakatseli, Cocarascu & Modgil (2024), EthiX
family_or_version: Walton scheme family; related S10P07 and S10P12
decision_rationale: High form and suite scores, but overlaps QT-SCHEMES and the dialectical tree corpus; useful only if topic diversity is required.
residual_gap: Limited formal and provenance coverage.

citation: Bezou-Vrakatseli, Cocarascu & Modgil (2025), Can Large Language Models Understand Argument Schemes?
family_or_version: enthymeme/scheme family
decision_rationale: Targets hidden premises, but its generated material overlaps QT-SCHEMES at form level and is less authentic than the selected argument-tree corpus.
residual_gap: Use for an enthymeme-specific follow-up.

citation: Mikuła et al. (2024), Magnushammer
family_or_version: formal-prover premise-selection family
secondary_coverage: Isabelle proof states and relevant premises
decision_rationale: Valuable second prover ecosystem, but it tests the same broad compatibility/premise-selection boundary as LeanDojo with higher environment cost.
residual_gap: Could be added for prover portability, not minimal coverage.

citation: Han et al. (2022/2024), FOLIO: Natural Language Reasoning with First-Order Logic
family_or_version: human-authored FOL reasoning family
decision_rationale: Highest aggregate mean and excellent argument-form score; excluded from the minimal core because its main value overlaps formal proof/skeleton checks, while LeanDojo supplies the stronger compatibility boundary.
residual_gap: Strong candidate for the primary benchmark if proof execution is unavailable.

citation: Hu et al. (2023), Won't Get Fooled Again: Answering Questions with False Premises
family_or_version: false-premise family; related PCBench/KG-FPQ
secondary_coverage: human-written false premises, explanations, revised true-premise questions
decision_rationale: Useful human-written complement to PCBench, but PCBench has the stronger diagnosticity and premise-critique score for the core invalid-inference slot.
residual_gap: Use as an authenticity/transfer check for premise critique.
